metadata.question: Was the area of aritifical land built off the coast of Jakarata Bay greater than 800 hectares as of 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need to identify artificial land built in Jakarta Bay - Use high-resolution imagery (Sentinel-2) for 2021 - Focus on coastal area of Jakarta Bay, Indonesia - Will need to compare land vs water classification or use land cover data 2. Masking strategy: - Mask clouds to get clear view of land - May need to use NDWI or land/water classification - Could use ESA WorldCover or Dynamic World for land classification 3. Logic: - Calculate area of artificial/built-up land in coastal Jakarta Bay - Compare to 800 hectares (8,000,000 m²) - Valid zero would mean <800 ha exists (answer B) - Need to ensure we're capturing reclaimed land areas - C3 if calculation fails or returns invalid values ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Define Jakarta Bay area - focus on known reclamation zones # Northern Jakarta coastline where major reclamation occurred jakarta_bay = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[106.7, -6.05], [106.95, -6.05], [106.95, -6.15], [106.7, -6.15], [106.7, -6.05]] ]) # 2. Use ESA WorldCover 2021 for built-up area classification worldcover = ee.ImageCollection("ESA/WorldCover/v200").first() # Get built-up areas (class 50) built_up = worldcover.select('Map').eq(50) # 3. Also check with Dynamic World for validation dw = ee.ImageCollection('GOOGLE/DYNAMICWORLD/V1') \ .filterBounds(jakarta_bay) \ .filterDate('2021-01-01', '2021-12-31') print(f"Dynamic World images: {dw.size().getInfo()}") if dw.size().getInfo() == 0: print("No Dynamic World data, using WorldCover only") final_built = built_up else: # Get built class from Dynamic World (label 6 = built) dw_mean = dw.select('built').mean() dw_built = dw_mean.gt(0.5) # Combine both sources - area is built if either shows built final_built = built_up.Or(dw_built) # 4. Calculate area of built-up land in Jakarta Bay area_calc = final_built.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()) stats = area_calc.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=jakarta_bay, scale=10, maxPixels=1e9 ) built_area_m2 = stats.get('Map').getInfo() if built_area_m2 is None: built_area_m2 = stats.get('built').getInfo() # 5. Check pixel count for validation pixel_count = final_built.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=jakarta_bay, scale=10, maxPixels=1e9 ).values().getInfo()[0] print(f"Valid pixels: {int(pixel_count)}") if pixel_count == 0: print("No valid pixels detected") print("C2") elif built_area_m2 is None: print("Calculation failed") print("C3") else: built_area_ha = built_area_m2 / 10000 print(f"Built-up area in Jakarta Bay 2021: {built_area_ha:.2f} hectares") print(f"Threshold: 800 hectares") if built_area_ha > 800: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Define Jakarta Bay area - focus on known reclamation zones
# Northern Jakarta coastline where major reclamation occurred
jakarta_bay = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [[106.7, -6.05],
     [106.95, -6.05],
     [106.95, -6.15],
     [106.7, -6.15],
     [106.7, -6.05]]
])

# 2. Use ESA WorldCover 2021 for built-up area classification
worldcover = ee.ImageCollection("ESA/WorldCover/v200").first()

# Get built-up areas (class 50)
built_up = worldcover.select('Map').eq(50)

# 3. Also check with Dynamic World for validation
dw = ee.ImageCollection('GOOGLE/DYNAMICWORLD/V1') \
    .filterBounds(jakarta_bay) \
    .filterDate('2021-01-01', '2021-12-31')

print(f"Dynamic World images: {dw.size().getInfo()}")

if dw.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No Dynamic World data, using WorldCover only")
    final_built = built_up
else:
    # Get built class from Dynamic World (label 6 = built)
    dw_mean = dw.select('built').mean()
    dw_built = dw_mean.gt(0.5)
    
    # Combine both sources - area is built if either shows built
    final_built = built_up.Or(dw_built)

# 4. Calculate area of built-up land in Jakarta Bay
area_calc = final_built.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea())

stats = area_calc.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
    geometry=jakarta_bay,
    scale=10,
    maxPixels=1e9
)

built_area_m2 = stats.get('Map').getInfo()

if built_area_m2 is None:
    built_area_m2 = stats.get('built').getInfo()

# 5. Check pixel count for validation
pixel_count = final_built.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry=jakarta_bay,
    scale=10,
    maxPixels=1e9
).values().getInfo()[0]

print(f"Valid pixels: {int(pixel_count)}")

if pixel_count == 0:
    print("No valid pixels detected")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
elif built_area_m2 is None:
    print("Calculation failed")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
else:
    built_area_ha = built_area_m2 / 10000
    print(f"Built-up area in Jakarta Bay 2021: {built_area_ha:.2f} hectares")
    print(f"Threshold: 800 hectares")
    
    if built_area_ha > 800:
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print("<answer>B</answer>")
